'''Spaceport 27''' was a small, little-used freight pad located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Sinasu]] kept his [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] [[Red Nebula (starship)|''Red Nebula'']] docked at the pad.
